reason: I've paid for promo apps before that brought me nobody, and this one isn't even public yet. I'm not committing to a 3-month minimum on a platform with no users I can see.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? A launch price means nothing to me if the crowd isn't on it, and I'd be locked in for 3 months.
would_change_my_mind: Real proof of downloads and active users in my area, or a no-commitment month-to-month trial where I only pay once it has brought people through my door.
